document:483.text:
Dear Adventurer,
I have a mission for you. Head to the <style="highlight">cliffs south of the tea party</style>, defeat the evil guards protecting the <style="highlight">finest fruit</style> in the world, and bring it back. Then, place it on <style="highlight">the platter with waffles and cupcakes</style>.
Complete this mission, and I'll treat you to the most delicious cake in the world!

<align="right">A Nameless Hamster
document:483.source_cn:
勇敢的冒险者：
你能去<style="highlight">茶会正南方的悬崖附近</style>，击败看守果实的邪恶守卫，采集到<style="highlight">最好的果实</style>，并将它带回这里，放到<style="highlight">盛有华夫饼与纸杯蛋糕的餐盘中</style>吗？
如果你能做到上述要求，就让你见识见识最好吃的蛋糕，没错，是全世界最好吃的！

<align="right">一位不愿意透露姓名的仓鼠人
